body.x: Iqua, Finish bluetooth acceessories manufactuer, has released its new bluetooth headrest hands-free for car at CES 2006. The ''Snake'' -the name of the model- is designed to promote safer in-car communications. If you install this model to the headrest of your car seat, it helps you to adjust it to fit your height with flexible neck mechanism and enjoy a comfortable communication environment. This will be released in the market in February 2006 and it will cost 160(USD).
